description: Saves something about this person's taste, only when THEY ask for it to be remembered for a series or for all their videos ("always", "for this series", "from now on"); a note on one video is fixed in that video and not remembered. Dials move one step at a time relative to the look's defaults.

dials.description: Steps per dial, −2…+2: energy (+ more energetic / − calmer); pace (+ faster, more cuts / − slower, longer holds); density (+ denser, more layers / − simpler, fewer things on screen); depth (+ more 3D, camera moves and depth / − flatter, more graphic); text (+ bigger type, fewer words / − smaller type, more words); sfx (+ more, punchier effects / − fewer, subtler effects); music (+ music louder / − music quieter under the voice)

dislikes.description: Short notes on what they disliked or want different

likes.description: Short notes on what they liked

scope.description: account: all their videos; series: one series

series.description: The series' name, for scope series (or give the video)

video.description: A video in the series, for scope series

name: remember_taste
title: Remember their taste
